data.one_liner: Client authentication library for Serverpod backends.
data.what_it_does: Serverpod authentication client providing integration for sign-in features and authentication state management with a Serverpod backend. It handles authentication flows for applications built on the Serverpod platform.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Serverpod as your backend server.
You need to handle user authentication sessions in a Serverpod application.
avoid_when: You are using Firebase, Supabase, or another backend instead of Serverpod.
You only need local device biometrics without a remote server.
strengths: Seamlessly integrates with the Serverpod ecosystem.
Supports cross-platform targets including Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Serverpod backend framework.
Documentation outside of the main Serverpod site is minimal.
data.setup_notes: Requires a running Serverpod backend and generation of client endpoints.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Firebase as your backend instead of Serverpod.
